lines.text: Israel is to obey so they may prosper and multiply in a land flowing with milk and honey.
The LORD is One, and Israel must love Him with all their heart, soul, and strength.
Israel is to tie these words on their hands and foreheads and write them on their doorposts and gates.
When satisfied in the promised land, Israel must not forget the LORD who freed them from Babylon.
Moses tells Israel not to test the LORD as they tested Him at Meribah.
